text:
maya: heads-up — planning to flip feature_flag.dynamic_routing from safe-default=true -> false for EU at 22:00 UTC today. Need an owner to click the toggle and someone to run smoke checks.
raul: i can take the toggle click. i'll be on standby from 21:45 UTC.
eli: i'll run smoke tests and watch metrics (p99 latency, error-rate, 95th token cost). i'll be available 21:50–22:30 UTC.
jun: i'll be on-call for rollback if anything weird pops up. what are the exact smoke steps?
maya: thanks — quick checklist: 1) flip toggle for eu-rolling group to 5% (canary) 2) run smoke script against canary domain 3) monitor p95/p99 + model fallback traces 4) increase to 25% after 10m if healthy 5) full flip at 30m.
eli: smoke script (local):
```
./smoke.sh --env eu --route /generate --samples 20 --prompt "ping" --assert 200
```
eli: metrics to watch: `inference.latency.p99.eu`, `routing.fallback.count`, `token_cost.avg`
raul: got it. i'll do step 1 at T+0. if i see errors, i'll immediately set flag back to safe-defaults=true.
maya: rollback command if we need to revert config (ops CLI):
```
opsctl feature set dynamic_routing --scope eu --value true --actor raul --reason "auto-rollback"
```
jun: can we also gate by model-variant? last time a variant mismatch caused a tiny spike.
maya: yes — toggle is scoped to routing-only not model selection, but i'll pin model-variant stable-v3 for eu during the rollout.
devops-bot: @channel scheduled window created: flip-dynamic-routing-eu @ 2024-05-23T22:00:00Z, owners: raul (flip), eli (smoke), jun (rollback). Incident channel: #incidents (standby).
eli: one more ask — please confirm no promos or heavy traffic windows in that time.
raul: confirmed: no marketing sends, small expected traffic due to timezone.
maya: i'll post a final "we're 5m" message 5 minutes before. if anyone cannot make their slot, call it out now.
jun: all good from me.
eli: i'll run the smoke script manually and then kick off the automated harness for steady-state checks.
raul: flipping now to 5% canary. :thumbsup:
eli: running smoke script... :eyes:
eli: smoke pass — 20/20, p99 120ms, no fallback hits. increasing to 25% in 2m.
maya: copying checklist into release notes channel after full flip.
raul: increasing to 25%... done.
eli: 10m steady, metrics look clean. ready for full flip at 22:30 UTC.
maya: full flip at 22:30, go/no-go?
jun: go from me. monitoring on-call continues.
raul: flipped to 100%. :shipit:
eli: post-flip checks: 1) run smoke.sh 2) sanity queries on main traffic 3) check `routing.fallback.count` and `errors` 4) verify rollout flag status in console.
eli: all post-flip smoke OK. no spikes.
maya: awesome — i'll close the window and add notes to the ops playbook. thanks everyone! :tada:
